question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS delivered_ts,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year_num,
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month_num
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
),
month_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month_num AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year_num = 2016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2016,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year_num = 2017 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2017,
        SUM(CASE WHEN year_num = 2018 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2018
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY month_num
)
SELECT 
    LPAD(CAST(month AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') AS month,
    CAST(cnt_2016 AS INTEGER) AS "2016",
    CAST(cnt_2017 AS INTEGER) AS "2017",
    CAST(cnt_2018 AS INTEGER) AS "2018"
FROM month_counts
ORDER BY month
